## How tested

- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm -r build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated where the change warrants them
- [ ] `pnpm changeset` run — a changeset is included if published
      behaviour changed (minor for features/breaking, patch for fixes)
- [ ] For UI changes: checked light **and** dark mode, keyboard focus
      and `prefers-reduced-motion`
